translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: King Kxetu Kc Tqngi Nardr Pris Ne Yawe

content.text: Yawe rpibzle mz King kc tqngi Kxetu rnge kx, “Wxbu mrlc tqmatq-esz'ngr mz nrlarnge kxrtc,
Navz nakrlz-zpwxbzle mzli kc nangi-batr-ngrbo mz enqmi rmqng nzmetx-krbzlr bam.”
Murde Yawe sa nangi-batr-kzpzle nzetunepxkr zmatq ngrm mz nzvzpx-krme Jerusalem,
X mzli lcde, drtq leplz nemqng sa navq zlwz nzprtr-krbzlr mz ami nem,
Murde namailzq nidr mz zmatq ngrm kc tqluli, tqtr.
X obla nemqng sa navzmqng naprtr-kzpzng bam mz nzaxplr-mou-krdr ami nem.
Na-apubzlr badr mi kc tqvzom mz nzrka-krbzle nzlungr kxmrna mz nabr.
X Yawe esalz-ngrde drtqde x trnatekqtrleu drtwrde.
Rpile kx, “Nim King nenge, nangini-alo-kzp pris mz nzvz-nqblq-krde nzwzkr Melkesidek.”
X Yawe sa natubz mz nibrm,
Mz nzmilxtxo-krde king kxnzkqlung mz zngya ngr drtwrde.
X sa na-ayrplapxle lr mrkzbleng mz nznibqti-krde nidr amrlx.
X sa na-aovxio-atwrnr-ngrde king rdrng mz nrlc tulvzo.
X nim, King rnge, mz nzvz-krm lc, nzxplr-kato-krm sa namatqnepx kz.
